Freo's optional MP3 analysis decoder

mpg123-decoder 1.0.3, Copyright 2021-2025 Ethan Halsall (MIT).
Unmodified npm distribution: mpg123-decoder/dist/mpg123-decoder.min.js
SHA-256: c13a80f0455795eb0c8a1c7844fb5e567cf37acc00fdd3e1f3e6b89f7b4601ce
Source: https://github.com/eshaz/wasm-audio-decoders
Revision: 8f2428c1cd96b54dab74836c8471ff75fe35cbee
The bundle includes the upstream common decoder utilities and simple-yenc by
Ethan Halsall, distributed under MIT terms, and the puff decompressor whose
copyright/license notices are retained in the included source archive.

The compiled mpg123 library is Copyright (c) 1995-2020 Michael Hipp and others,
free software under the GNU LGPL v2.1. See mpg123-COPYING.txt and mpg123-AUTHORS.txt.
Source: https://github.com/madebr/mpg123
Revision: 08247b317163175e62035893af3ff9e71a5dfefd

Corresponding source and upstream build files are provided alongside this notice
in decoder-source.tar.gz. It contains the complete mpg123 source at the revision
above and the relevant wasm-audio-decoders wrapper/common/build sources. The
upstream repository can also be checked out at the exact revision with its
submodules to build a replacement using its documented Emscripten/npm workflow.
Freo loads this decoder from a separate, replaceable JavaScript file. It is not
linked into the player application bundle. No decoder source modifications were
made for this integration.
